deferred.independent_attestation: no independent attester exists; CERTIFIED states where the evidence was produced and never that it was attested
deferred.linux_environment_lock: the recorded environment lock covers osx-arm64 only (issue 45)

not_applicable.manuscript_claims: checked inside FAST by tests/test_manuscript_claims.py, so it has no separate evidence

optional.performance: scaling and timing measurements; reported and bound to the measurement fingerprint, never a gate

required.deep: mutation score of at least 95 % over the whole eligible scope, with the scope inventory checked
required.fast: tests, 100 % line and branch coverage of the scientific code, manuscript figures and claims
required.faults: every deliberate scientific defect is detected and the control run passes
required.real: the three full research datasets exist locally, match the reference hashes and pass their checks
required.reproduction: cardio is reproduced against the archive, between two runs and in an environment rebuilt from the lock
required.tools: 100 % line and branch coverage of the verifier code in verification/
required.types: the typing gate with the pinned checker and stubs, no new error and no stale baseline entry
